name: verifier reports a requirement delivered weaker than its wording as needing approval (#106)
prompt: Act as the verifier subagent (.claude/agents/verifier.md) for the change folder evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0001-floor-mode, but do only step 5 (what was delivered, against each requirement), doing the comparison yourself, one requirement at a time: don't run make check, scripts or the plan's commands. The change's code is in evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/code/ (floor_model.py and dock.py). Write your report to report.md in the repo root, in the order the verifier's instructions give, and don't edit any other file.
check: grep -q 'Descope: needs approval' report.md && grep -qi 'generates' report.md && scripts/clause-check.sh --stage build evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0001-floor-mode | jq -e 'any(.[]; .requirement == "R1" and .gap == "large" and .approved == null)'
